Name: Better Meteorites
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Better Meteorites[/b] improves loot dropped by meteorites. They drop a lot of stone, coal, iridium ore, and geodes.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Just break meteorites and they'll drop many more items.

[SPOILER]Specifically:
[list]
[*]75 to 249 stone;
[*]50 to 149 iridium;
[*]20 to 74 coal;
[*]7 to 21 geodes;
[*]7 to 21 frozen geodes;
[*]7 to 21 magma geodes;
[*]and 3 to 11 omni geodes.[/SPOILER]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
